products.title: A*S*L Individual Wedges – Steel Shafts
products.body_html:
Simplify Your Short Game — One Wedge at a Time

The Edison Golf A•S•L Wedges were created to take the confusion out of wedge selection and give golfers purpose-built tools for the scoring shots that matter most.

Choose the wedge that fits your game:

A = Approach Wedge (49°)
For full and partial approach shots where distance control and precision matter.

S = Sand Wedge (54°)
A versatile scoring wedge for bunkers, pitches, chips and shots around the green.

L = Lob Wedge (59°)
For higher, softer shots when you need trajectory, spin and stopping power around the green.

No second-guessing.
No complicated wedge labels.
Just choose the right tool for the shots you need to hit.

Built with Edison Golf’s revolutionary high-CG construction and premium forged feel, every A•S•L Wedge is engineered to deliver more consistent distance control, predictable trajectory and exceptional forgiveness—especially when contact isn't perfect.

Paired with premium KBS PGI Graphite Shafts, this configuration provides a smooth, lightweight feel with vibration dampening designed to help golfers improve consistency and confidence throughout the scoring zone.

Choose Your Wedge

  • A Wedge – 49° | Approach & scoring shots

  • S Wedge – 54° | Sand, pitching & all-around versatility

  • L Wedge – 59° | Lob shots & greenside precision

Each wedge includes:

  • Premium KBS PGI Graphite Shaft

  • Lamkin Golf grip

  • Right-handed configuration

  • Custom shaft length

  • Custom lie angle

Why Golfers Love Edison A•S•L Wedges

  • Simple, purpose-driven wedge selection

  • Exceptional forgiveness on off-center strikes

  • Consistent distance, spin and trajectory control

  • Lightweight graphite shaft performance

  • Reduced vibration for improved feel

  • Versatile sole design for multiple turf and sand conditions

  • Premium forged construction with soft feel and feedback

Whether you need more confidence attacking the pin, escaping bunkers or playing delicate shots around the green, choose the Edison A•S•L Wedge that fills the biggest need in your short game.

Approach. Sand. Lob. Pick the tool your game needs.

30-Day Risk-Free Guarantee

We want you to experience the Edison difference on the course—not just read about it.

Play your Edison A*S*L Scoring Set for 30 days. If you’re not completely satisfied, simply return the wedges for a full refund of the purchase price.

That’s how confident we are these wedges can help improve your scoring performance.

2026 Edison 2.0 Scoring Set – Graphite Shafts

The 2026 Edison 2.0 Scoring Set is a complete 3-wedge system engineered to help golfers improve consistency, distance control, and confidence from 100 yards and in.

The 2026 Edison 2.0 Scoring Set provides golfers with three properly gapped wedges designed to work together seamlessly throughout the scoring zone.

Rather than piecing together mismatched wedges with inconsistent loft gaps and performance characteristics, the Edison Scoring Set delivers a complete short game solution built for real golfers.

Available in four optimized loft configurations:

  • 49° / 53° / 57°
  • 50° / 54° / 58°
  • 51° / 55° / 59°
  • 52° / 56° / 60°

Each Edison wedge features our revolutionary high center of mass design that creates more consistent spin, trajectory, and distance control — especially on shots struck low on the face where most golfers miss.

Combined with Edison’s signature dual-bounce sole design, these wedges perform exceptionally well from tight lies, rough, bunkers, and wet turf conditions.

Included in Your Edison Scoring Set

  • Three Edison 2.0+ wedges
  • Premium KBS PGI Graphite Shafts
  • Choice of loft progression
  • Choice of shaft flex
  • Choice of grip size
  • Choice of shaft length
  • Choice of lie angle

Why Golfers Love the 2026 Edison 2.0 Scoring Set

  • Better distance gapping throughout the scoring clubs
  • More forgiveness on off-center strikes
  • Tour-level spin and control

Built as a Complete Scoring System

Most golfers buy wedges one at a time.

The Edison Scoring Set was engineered differently.

Each loft progression is designed to create proper yardage gaps and more reliable short game performance, helping golfers play with greater confidence around the greens.

30-Day Performance Guarantee

We believe the Edison Scoring Set can improve your short game confidence and consistency almost immediately.

Play them for 30 days. If they don’t outperform your current wedges, return them for a full refund.

Free shipping included within the Continental United States.

products.title: 2026 Edison 2.0 Wedges - Graphite Shafts
products.body_html:
2026 Edison 2.0 Wedges - Graphite Shafts

Includes KBS PGI Graphite Shafts, Lamkin Grips, and Custom Length & Lie Adjustments at No Additional Charge.

Built for Your Game. Engineered to Help You Score.

The 2026 Edison 2.0 Wedge combines revolutionary weighting technology, a versatile dual-bounce sole, and custom-built specifications to deliver the consistency and forgiveness recreational golfers need inside the scoring zone.

Unlike traditional wedges that place too much weight low in the clubhead, Edison wedges feature a high center of mass design that improves distance control and consistency across the face — especially on the shots most golfers miss slightly low.

The result is more predictable carry distances, improved trajectory control, and greater confidence on every scoring shot.

Every Edison 2.0 wedge is built to your specifications at no additional charge, including custom length and lie adjustments to match your swing and setup.

Why Golfers Choose Edison

  • High Center of Mass Design for improved distance control
  • Dual Bounce Sole performs from tight lies, rough, bunkers, and wet turf
  • 5X Forged Face delivers exceptional feel and consistency
  • Custom Length and Lie Included at No Additional Charge
  • Built-to-Order in the USA
  • Backed by a 30-Day Risk-Free Trial

Included Standard Build

Every Edison 2.0 wedge includes:

  • KBS PGI Graphite Shafts
  • Lamkin Grips
  • Custom Length Adjustment (if desired)
  • Custom Lie Adjustment (if desired)

Upgrade options including graphite shafts, premium steel shafts, and additional grip choices are available during the build process.

Available Lofts

Available in lofts from 49° through 60°.

Edison wedges are manufactured in our signature odd-numbered lofts (49°, 51°, 53°, 55°, 57°, and 59°). If you prefer an even-numbered loft, we will professionally bend the wedge 1° during the build process at no additional charge.

Whether you prefer a traditional three-wedge setup or a fully customized scoring package, you can build the exact loft configuration that fits your game.

Confidence Comes Standard

Every Edison 2.0 wedge is backed by our 30-Day Risk-Free Trial, so you can experience The Edison Difference on your course, under real playing conditions.

If your Edison wedges don't help you play better scoring golf, return them within 30 days for a full refund.

Edison Liberty 3 Wedge Set

Celebrate American craftsmanship, American style, and better golf with the Edison Liberty Wedge Set.

Available in both right- and left-handed models, the Liberty Wedge Set combines the scoring performance of Edison wedges with the bold styling of KBS HI-REV 2.0 Liberty Edition shafts and Golf Pride MCC grips.

Featuring your choice of Red, White, or Blue shaft and grip combinations, each Liberty Wedge Set includes three custom-built Edison wedges assembled to your specifications for loft, length, lie angle, and grip size.

Built for Better Scoring

From full-swing approach shots to delicate pitches and greenside bunker shots, the Edison Liberty Wedge Set is designed to help you attack every scoring opportunity with confidence.

products.body_html:
